name: fmp_press_releases
description:
Company press releases for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP): date, title and text.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/press-releases as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, sent as given, e.g. AAPL), limit (integer; sent only when given).
For third-party news use fmp_stock_news; for filings fmp_sec_filings.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 10}
